items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Bill Moore was a beautiful trumpet player. He joined me during the war days.

ctx.x: So, that tune wasn't down on paper cause that was taken from the head of Avery Parrish. So, he played it, and he played it more like Avery than anybody I've heard play it.
Bill Moore was a beautiful trumpet player. He joined me during the war days. He was a beautiful trumpet player then.
And, Charlie Jones. I got him out of Texas. He was a trumpet player there with me for awhile.
